completion:
Write the first draft.
3. Revise.

## Start with the research records.
Make note cards using the data.
Create a code book for the cards to ensure consistency and accuracy (“the participant stated: This method is what I would use in my kitchen [p. 42]”).
Start with the data gathered in a previous study if it is available.
Once you complete the entire procedure, use the data to figure out what was observed and what happened.
Write the findings on a note card.<eos>
